docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Volume 11 of the Hortus Malabaricus, the great illustrated flora of Kerala compiled with the help of Ayurvedic physicians, with the plants’ Malayalam, Konkani and Sanskrit names and their medicinal uses (Amsterdam, 1692). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned and hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Hortus Indicus Malabaricus Volume 11 · Reede tot Drakestein, Hendrik van · 1692, 155 scanned pages. Published 1692; Hendrik van Rheede died 1691 and the other contributors lived in the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
